component.name: Mithrandir
component.summary: Blazing-fast Linux system cleaner, real-time hardware telemetry, hardware power saver, and system tray integration in Rust

description.p: Mithrandir is a high-performance system maintenance suite, cleaner, and diagnostic toolkit rewritten entirely in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It delivers instantaneous cleanup scans, deep cache pruning, hardware power management, and granular control over startup services and system processes without background resource overhead.

Designed with a focus on safety and transparency, Mithrandir protects critical operating system paths, features a quarantined ClamAV vault, and runs diagnostic telemetry off the main UI thread for completely stutter-free operation.

ul.li: High-Throughput Cleaner: Multi-threaded cleanup for package caches, thumbnails, application logs, and Flatpak runtimes
Hardware Power Saver: One-click CPU Turbo disabling, EPP power profiles, and PCIe ASPM deep power saving
Pure Rust System Tray: StatusNotifierItem and DBusMenu panel integration adapting automatically to Light/Dark desktop themes
Zero-Sleep Real-Time Telemetry: Instant CPU delta calculation, dual GPU metrics, and battery health reporting
Debounced Smart Boost: Safe one-click memory optimization and temporary file reclamation
Quarantine Vault: Integrated ClamAV scanning with secure isolation for flagged files
Integrated Mini-LLM Manager: One-click download and execution of local GGUF models via llama.cpp or Ollama
Dual AI Diagnostics: Real-time diagnostic assistance powered by local offline models or Google Gemini and Claude APIs

description.p: Mithrandir v0.5.0 introduces unified rebranding, robust Flatpak sandbox cache safety, and CachyOS BORE/sched-ext hardware scheduler controls:

ul.li: Strict Flatpak sandbox cache protection preventing accidental configuration or profile deletion.
Direct support for CachyOS BORE and sched-ext BPF scheduler management.
Mithrandir presets across system power profiles, CPU governors, EPP, and Turbo Boost.

description.p: Mithrandir v0.4.4 introduces major codebase optimizations, reliability fixes, and persistent user preferences.
